verdicts.reason: A: the dark logo panel bleeds off the top edge and is cut off oddly. The orange rule and eyebrow float underneath it, out of reading order. The body copy is jammed against the top edge, the CTA nearly touches the right edge, and the legal text is too small to read. The headline is modest but at least has room to breathe. B: same broken structure, with a bigger headline and eyebrow that give stronger hierarchy. But the headline is crammed against the logo panel and the body column and nearly fills the full height. It has the same edge-hugging copy and CTA and the same unreadable fine print, so it looks more cramped overall.
